ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Vendor shall (a) provide transition assistance for up to 6 months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 gives us no right to transition help or to get our Customer Data back, so we added a new 10.3 at our preferred position: up to 6 months' assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, then deletion with written certification. We removed the request-based trigger and the Order Form trigger so the return deadline runs from expiry or termination of this Agreement and cannot disturb live Services.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 10.3 requiring up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after return.
